Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary to activities on tid, assays to activities on assay_id, molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, and compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1293197, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
